summary: Radial dial: a ring that sweeps like a clock hand. Pushed by value, or timed and run by the client. For cooldowns, charges and channels.

placements.doc: Dial codes the layout has: c around the crosshair, b above the HUD at the bottom centre, bl and br above the HUD in the bottom corners (DialLayout.Placements).

panels.doc: The dial. Author it with class `hidden`. `size-sm`, `size-md`, `size-lg`, `size-xl` set the ring size.
Label under the ring. `empty` when blank.
Label in the middle of the ring. `empty` when blank.
The swept ring, drawn with `clip: radial()`. `step-N` is the pushed value (N of DialLayout.Steps). `timed` runs on its own: `dur-N` is the seconds, `up` fills instead of draining, `run` starts it.

texts.doc: DialOptions.ValueText, or the percentage under ShowPercent
